X.note: The terrain map, stacked gold coins, wagon and canal boat give a clear place and a clear quantity: the tall stack against a single coin. The lighting is soft and the outlines are clean. The ruler gizmos are small and cryptic. The wagon's ×10 tag is tiny. The labels crowd the objects, and the 'ACTUAL' badge is repeated three times. The footer text is a bit small.

Y.note: Three plain cubes sit on a dark grid with no context. The 7%, 6% and 13% labels sit on top of the cubes and cover them. The 13% label is half-faded and unreadable against the cube behind it. The cube sizes do not match the values: 13% is not clearly larger than 7%. The scene is mostly empty dark space, with no building or stair to show what is measured. The text-card look dominates.

why: X shows a recognisable place and objects whose scale matches the numbers and has readable labels, while Y has overlapping, faded labels on abstract cubes that don't convey what they stand for.
top_fix_for_weaker: Move the labels off the cubes and make them fully opaque. Scale the cube heights to the values (13 vs 7 vs 6). Replace the cubes with a recognisable building and stair floor-plan model in a lit scene, and fill the frame by moving the camera closer.
